name: fourth-lateran-council
description: Innocent III gathered hundreds of bishops in Rome to set doctrine on the Eucharist and require yearly confession.

name: celestine-v-resigns
description: A hermit elected pope after a two-year deadlock gave up the office within months, a rare papal abdication.

name: council-constance-ends-schism
description: A council deposed or accepted the rival claimants and elected Martin V, reuniting the Western Church under one pope.

name: alexander-vi-elected-pope
description: A Spanish cardinal reputedly bought his way to the papal throne and went on to rule as a notorious pope.

name: clement-xiv-suppresses-jesuits
description: Under pressure from Catholic monarchs, the pope dissolved the Society of Jesus across the world.

name: pius-ix-elected-pope
description: A reform-minded cardinal became pope and went on to hold the office longer than anyone in history apart from Peter.

name: papal-infallibility-declared
description: The First Vatican Council defined that the pope cannot err when he teaches on faith and morals from his chair.

name: benedict-xvi-elected-pope
description: White smoke rose over the Sistine Chapel as a German cardinal succeeded the long-serving Polish pope.

name: francis-elected-first-latin-american-pope
description: A cardinal from Argentina was chosen days after the pope stepped down, the first Latin American to lead the Church.

name: leo-xiv-elected-first-american-pope
description: A cardinal from Chicago was elected after the death of Francis, the first pope born in the United States.
